violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Observed raw chicken stored above cooked potato in 3 DR UPR Euerest refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving refrigeration units below or separated from all cooked foods. PIC placed raw chicken below cooked potato.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed a glass cleaner spray bottle hanging on the shelving unit storing clean food storage containers. Observed a spray bottle of sanitizer being stored on the counter next to unwrapped to-go containers.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. PIC MOVED THE SPRAY BOTTLES AWAY FROM ALL FOOD AND FOOD-RELATED ITEMS.

violations.title: Equip/Utensils, Durable under Normal Use
violations.observation: The following equipment is not designed and constructed to be durable: rice storage container and sugar storage containers are residential-use storage bins.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment and utensils shall be designed and constructed to be durable and to retain their characteristic qualities under normal use conditions. Food contact equipment shall be properly rated for cleaning, sanitization and re-use.
